svg.title: Recovery Bed: percentage and effective level
svg.desc: Example: a level 10 patient, a 30% ceiling and a speed of 1 percentage point per second. Owner configures the bed: Ceiling: /unrp recoverybed cap 30 Speed: /unrp recoverybed rate 1 Patient lies down: RecoveryBedBlock starts medical rest. The server checks whether treatment is needed. Advance treatment: Add 1 percentage point each treatment second. Leaving the bed pauses this course. Reach the ceiling: At 30%, lift the timed ability disable. The ability is usable at the recovered fraction. Use the effective level: 10 × 30 / 100 = level 3 Keep the original level 10 in the saved profile. Continue recovery later: A higher ceiling allows further treatment. At 100%, effective level returns to 10.
svg.text: Recovery Bed: percentage and effective level
Example: a level 10 patient, a 30% ceiling and a speed of 1 percentage point per second.
The server checks whether treatment is needed.
Add 1 percentage point each treatment second.
Leaving the bed pauses this course.
At 30%, lift the timed ability disable.
The ability is usable at the recovered fraction.
Keep the original level 10 in the saved profile.
A higher ceiling allows further treatment.
The recovered fraction persists after leaving, reconnecting and the old disable deadline.
Speed controls treatment time. Ceiling controls how much ability is restored.
